Dana

The subject is "Tamsin 2027 rate" and it has the proposed 2027 per-seat rate of $2,274 for the Petrel pricing review. It's only a draft, so nothing has been sent. Dana will send it herself. I saved Dana's Tamsin Cold Chain draft to Tobias and told June in her DM.

- **The draft:** It goes to Tobias Rendle at trendle@pemberline.com, an internal address, so it doesn't need Ruth's approval. The subject is "Tamsin 2027 rate", and it gives the proposed 2027 rate of $2,274 per seat for the Petrel pricing review.
- **Why June's OK counts:** On 14 Oct, Dana asked in #north-random for June's sign-off because Tobias isn't on the Tamsin account, and the request was logged as waiting on June. June is the deal desk, so she can approve it. She's also in #north-random, where that request was made.
- **Not sent:** It's only a draft. Dana said she'll send it herself.
- **Whose mailbox:** The tool saves drafts to "this member's mailbox" and doesn't say whose that is. I couldn't confirm the draft landed in Dana's drafts, so it's worth having her check.
- **What I told June:** Her approval covers only this draft. The separate Quarrendon rate draft to Hollis Mbeki is still waiting for her OK in #north-random.
